title: Beauty, Wellness & Personal Care
tagline: Cosmetology, nutrition, AYUSH, naturopathy, Siddha, aromatherapy — accessibility-first careers with strong entrepreneurship potential.
overview: India's beauty, wellness, and AYUSH ecosystem is a quietly massive employer — VLCC, Lakmé, and Shahnaz Husain academies plus thousands of NSDC Beauty & Wellness Sector Skill Council (B&WSSC) centres train tens of thousands annually, while AYUSH ministry funding has expanded BAMS, BHMS, BUMS, Siddha, and BNYS seats across 700+ colleges. The 2026 reality: yoga teacher certification (RYT-200, QCI Level 2) is a low-cost (₹15K-50K) skill-first credential with strong overseas demand; nutrition & dietetics (₹50K-3L for BSc) opens hospital, sports, corporate-wellness pathways at ₹3-8 LPA fresh; personal-trainer ACE/NASM/ISSA certs (₹15-50K) lead to gym-chain jobs at Cult.fit/Talwarkars at ₹2.5-6 LPA. The hidden gem: govt cosmetology certs under PMKVY are free for eligible candidates and lead to salon employment within 3-6 months. Note: BAMS, BHMS, BUMS appear in the Medicine domain (Run 1) as clinical AYUSH paths; here they are reframed from a wellness/preventive-care angle for completeness.
key_insights: Yoga teacher certification (RYT-200 via Yoga Alliance, or QCI Level 2 under Govt of India) costs ₹15K-50K and opens international wellness-tourism work in UAE, USA, Europe paying $40-100/hr.
Nutrition & dietetics is one of the fastest-growing wellness careers — corporate wellness (Cult.fit, HealthifyMe), hospital dietetics, sports nutrition, all hiring fresher BSc grads at ₹3-8 LPA.
VLCC and Lakmé Academy graduates regularly find Gulf salon employment paying ₹50K-1L/month — a serious migration path almost no middle-class family considers.
BNYS (Bachelor of Naturopathy & Yogic Sciences) is a 5.5-year AYUSH degree at govt fees ₹20K-2L total, opening preventive-medicine and wellness-resort medical-officer paths at ₹3-6 LPA fresh.

Personal training (ACE/NASM-certified) at Indian gym chains starts at ₹2.5-6 LPA but tier-1 city personal trainers at premium gyms (Anytime Fitness, Snap Fitness, Talwarkars) can clear ₹50K-1L/month with private clients.

sub_paths.name: Cosmetology / Salon Professional
sub_paths.description: Hair, skin, nails, makeup services — VLCC/Lakmé/Shahnaz Husain academy or NSDC B&WSSC route. Salon employment or self-employment.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 8th-10th pass; many programs have no academic cutoff
sub_paths.qualification: VLCC/Lakmé/Shahnaz Husain Diploma in Cosmetology OR NSDC B&WSSC certification
sub_paths.entrance_exam: Direct enrollment at academies; PMKVY enrollment at NSDC centres
sub_paths.govt_fees: Free under PMKVY for eligible candidates; govt ITI Beauty Care trade ₹5K-20K
sub_paths.private_fees: VLCC/Lakmé/Shahnaz Husain ₹30,000-2 lakh; Jawed Habib Academy ₹40K-1.5L
top_institutions: VLCC Institute of Beauty & Nutrition (private, India network)
Beauty & Wellness Sector Skill Council (semi-govt, NSDC SSC)
Govt ITIs - Beauty & Hair Care trade (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf salon industry hires Indian beauticians at ₹50-80K/month + tips. Spa/cruise-line industry global; UAE/Saudi salons consistently hiring.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Salon-based hair styling, facials, waxing, threading, makeup; long standing hours; busy weekends and bridal season. Self-employed beauticians do home visits.
sub_paths.growth_path: Trainee → Beautician → Senior Stylist → Salon Manager → Salon Owner / Bridal Specialist. Bridal makeup artists in metros earn ₹15K-1L per assignment.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.2-3 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): 3-7 LPA / Senior (salon owner / bridal artist): 6-25 LPA. Note: Chain salons (Lakmé Salon, Naturals, Jawed Habib) 2-4L start; Gulf placements 6-12L; senior bridal artists in tier-1 cities premium. Source: NSDC B&WSSC, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Hair Styling Specialist
sub_paths.description: Specialist in cutting, colouring, chemical treatments, extensions — premium salon work and celebrity styling.
sub_paths.qualification: Diploma in Hair Styling (Lakmé/Toni&Guy/Jawed Habib) OR NSDC Hair Stylist cert
sub_paths.govt_fees: Free under PMKVY for eligible; govt ITI ₹5K-20K
sub_paths.private_fees: Toni & Guy Academy 1-3 lakh; Jean-Claude Biguine Academy 80K-2 lakh; Lakmé Hair School 50K-1.5 lakh
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf salons + cruise lines actively hire Indian-trained hair stylists. UK/Australia hairdresser pathway via NVQ Level 2/3 bridge certifications.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Salon floor work — consultations, cuts, colours (3-4 hr appointments common), chemical services, blow-drying. Standing 8-10 hrs typical. Strong tip culture.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Stylist → Senior Stylist → Master Stylist / Educator → Salon Owner. Celebrity hair stylists (Aalim Hakim, Adhuna Bhabani) command premium.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.5-3 LPA / Mid: 3-8 LPA / Senior (master stylist / salon owner): 8-30 LPA. Note: Toni & Guy/BBlunt 2.5-5L start; celebrity stylists/independents earn ₹50K-3L/month variably; Gulf placements premium. Source: AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Dermal Esthetics / Advanced Skincare
sub_paths.description: Medical-grade facials, chemical peels, microdermabrasion, laser treatments at dermatology clinics and medi-spas.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 12th pass; some programs prefer Bio stream
sub_paths.qualification: Advanced Diploma in Dermal Esthetics / CIDESCO certification / VLCC Medical Cosmetology
sub_paths.govt_fees: Limited govt route; AIIMS/PGI hospital-based dermal-tech training nominal
sub_paths.private_fees: VLCC Medical Cosmetology 80K-2 lakh; CIDESCO India programs 1-3 lakh; Pivot Point International 1-2 lakh
top_institutions: Hospital-based clinical-trainee programs at major dermatology chains (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: CIDESCO certification globally recognized — UAE/UK/Singapore medi-spas hire actively. USA NCEA / Aesthetician License via state board for Indian-trained candidates.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Clinic-based work alongside dermatologists — consultations, machine-assisted treatments, post-treatment care, retail product recommendations. Cleaner clinical environment than salon.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Aesthetician → Senior → Lead Therapist → Clinic Manager / Owner. Kaya, Oliva, VLCC clinics, dermatologist private practices hire heavily.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2.5-5 LPA / Mid: 5-12 LPA / Senior: 10-25 LPA. Note: Kaya/Oliva 3-5L start; VLCC clinic 3-6L; Gulf medi-spas 6-12L; senior CIDESCO trainers higher. Source: AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Nutrition & Dietetics (BSc / MSc)
sub_paths.description: BSc/MSc in Nutrition & Dietetics — hospital dietitian, sports nutrition, corporate wellness, food-product development.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 50% (Bio strongly preferred); 55% for top govt colleges
sub_paths.qualification: BSc Nutrition & Dietetics (3 yrs) + MSc (2 yrs) + RD (Registered Dietitian)
duration: BSc 3 yrs + MSc 2 yrs + RD internship 6 mo
sub_paths.entrance_exam: CUET-UG/PG, Lady Irwin College entrance, university tests
sub_paths.govt_fees: Lady Irwin Delhi/IHE Delhi/SNDT Mumbai 50K-3 lakh total
sub_paths.private_fees: Symbiosis/Manipal/Christ ₹3-8 lakh BSc; ₹5-12 lakh MSc combo
top_institutions: All India Institute of Medical Sciences AIIMS - PG Dietetics (govt)
Symbiosis School of Biological Sciences Pune (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MSc / Registered Dietitian (RD) credentials in USA (CDR-accredited), UK (BDA), Australia (DAA). Strong UAE/Saudi/Singapore hospital dietitian roles.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Hospital ward rounds with doctors, diet planning for inpatients, outpatient counselling, kitchen liaison; or corporate-wellness 1:1 client sessions and group programs.
sub_paths.growth_path: Junior Dietitian → Senior Dietitian → Chief Dietitian / Sports Nutritionist / Corporate Wellness Lead. Apollo, Fortis, AIIMS, Cult.fit, HealthifyMe, Sports Authority of India hire heavily.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3-6 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): 6-14 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): 12-30 LPA. Note: Hospital dietitian 3-5L; HealthifyMe/Cult.fit 4-8L; sports nutrition (BCCI / IPL franchises) premium; Gulf hospital 8-15L. Source: AmbitionBox, IDA.

sub_paths.name: Yoga Teacher Certification (RYT-200 / QCI)
sub_paths.description: Yoga Alliance RYT-200 or Govt of India QCI-certified yoga teacher — schools, studios, wellness resorts, international online classes.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 10th-12th pass; some programs no formal academic cutoff
sub_paths.qualification: RYT-200 / RYT-500 (Yoga Alliance) OR QCI Level 1-4 (Govt of India)
duration: 1-12 months depending on level (200-hr course often 4-6 weeks intensive)
sub_paths.entrance_exam: Direct enrollment; QCI Level certification exam
sub_paths.govt_fees: QCI certification fee ₹2,500-10,000; govt-affiliated S-VYASA short courses ₹15K-50K
sub_paths.private_fees: Sivananda/Ashtanga/Iyengar institutes ₹30K-2 lakh; Rishikesh schools ₹40K-2L; S-VYASA MSc Yoga ₹50K-1L
top_institutions: Swami Vivekananda Yoga Anusandhana Samsthana (S-VYASA) Bangalore (govt-deemed)
Morarji Desai National Institute of Yoga (MDNIY) Delhi (govt)
Ramamani Iyengar Memorial Yoga Inst Pune (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Strongest direct international career — RYT-certified Indian yoga teachers in demand at studios/wellness resorts in USA, UK, UAE, Australia, Singapore. International rates $40-100/hr.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Group classes (1-3 hrs/day morning + evening), private 1:1 sessions, retreat work at wellness resorts, online classes via Zoom/YouTube/Insight Timer for global audiences.
sub_paths.growth_path: RYT-200 Teacher → RYT-500 → Studio Owner / Resort Yoga Director / International Trainer. International circuit (Bali, Goa, Rishikesh) for serious practitioners.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.5-4 LPA / Mid: 4-12 LPA / Senior (resort director / international trainer): 10-40 LPA. Note: Studio chains (Cult.fit yoga, SARVA, The Yoga Institute) 3-6L; Gulf wellness resorts 6-15L; international online teachers earn USD 1,500-5,000/mo. Source: AmbitionBox, Yoga Alliance.

sub_paths.name: Personal Training / Fitness Trainer
sub_paths.description: ACE/NASM/ISSA-certified personal trainer at gyms, studios, private clients. Cult.fit and gym-chain expansion driving demand.
sub_paths.qualification: ACE / NASM / ISSA / K11 / Reebok-FitnessFirst / Gold's Gym certifications
sub_paths.govt_fees: Limited govt route; SAI Sports Authority diploma ₹10K-50K; LNIPE Gwalior BPEd ₹20K-50K/yr
sub_paths.private_fees: K11 Mumbai ₹50K-1.5L; ACE/NASM/ISSA online ₹15K-50K; Gold's Gym Academy ₹40K-1L
top_institutions: K11 School of Fitness Sciences Mumbai (private)
Sports Authority of India (SAI) - National Inst of Sports Patiala (govt)
LNIPE Gwalior - Lakshmibai Nat Inst of Phys Education (govt)
International Sports Sciences Association ISSA India (private)
American Council on Exercise (ACE) India (private, online)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: ACE/NASM/ISSA certifications globally portable. UAE/Saudi/Singapore gym chains hire Indian-certified trainers at ₹50-80K/month + commissions.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Gym floor 1:1 client sessions (typically 4-8 hrs/day across morning + evening peaks), program design, nutrition basics, member acquisition and retention.
sub_paths.growth_path: Personal Trainer → Senior PT → Master Trainer → Studio Owner / Online Coach. Top trainers with social media following clear ₹1-3L/month from online coaching.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2.5-5 LPA / Mid: 5-12 LPA / Senior (master trainer / online coach): 10-30 LPA. Note: Cult.fit/Talwarkars/Gold's Gym 2.5-6L start; tier-1 personal trainers with private clients ₹50K-1L/month routinely; Gulf 6-12L. Source: AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Naturopathy / BNYS (Bachelor of Naturopathy & Yogic Sciences)
sub_paths.description: 5.5-year AYUSH degree — clinical naturopathy practice, wellness-resort medical-officer roles, drugless preventive medicine.
sub_paths.qualification: BNYS — 4.5 yrs academic + 1 yr compulsory internship
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NEET-UG (some states); KEA/KCET, KNRUHS, RGUHS, university-specific
sub_paths.govt_fees: Govt BNYS colleges 20K-2 lakh total; KSGH Mysuru ~50K-1L total; Govt Yoga & Naturopathy Medical College Chennai nominal
sub_paths.private_fees: S-VYASA Bangalore 5-15 lakh total; SDM Ujire 4-12 lakh; private deemed ₹5-15 lakh
top_institutions: Govt Yoga & Naturopathy Medical College Chennai (govt)
KSGH Medical College of Naturopathy & Yogic Sciences Mysuru (govt)
SDM College of Naturopathy & Yogic Sciences Ujire (private)
JSS Institute of Naturopathy & Yogic Sciences Coimbatore (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: WHO recognises traditional & complementary medicine; Indian BNYS holders work at wellness resorts in USA (with ND bridge), UAE, Maldives, Sri Lanka. Direct ND licence requires bridging studies.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Hydrotherapy, mud therapy, fasting therapy, diet counselling, yoga therapy, clinical consultations. Wellness-resort postings popular for fresh graduates.
sub_paths.growth_path: Naturopathic Doctor → Senior → Wellness-Resort Medical Officer / Independent Practice / AYUSH Govt MO. Medical Officer pay scale Level 10 (₹56,100 basic) at AYUSH ministry.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3-6 LPA / Mid: 6-12 LPA / Senior: 10-25 LPA. Note: Wellness resorts (Ananda, Atmantan, Soukya) 4-8L; AYUSH MO Level 10 ₹56,100 basic; Gulf wellness 8-15L; private practice variable. Source: AYUSH Ministry, courseguidance.in.

sub_paths.name: BAMS - Ayurveda (Wellness/Preventive Angle)
sub_paths.description: 5.5-year AYUSH degree in Ayurveda — preventive medicine, panchakarma practice, wellness resort, AYUSH ministry govt MO.
sub_paths.qualification: Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery (BAMS) — 4.5 yrs + 1 yr internship
sub_paths.govt_fees: Govt Ayurveda colleges ₹50K-3 lakh total; IPGT&RA Jamnagar nominal
sub_paths.private_fees: Private BAMS colleges ₹4-15 lakh total; deemed up to ₹20 lakh
top_institutions: Institute of Post Graduate Teaching & Research in Ayurveda (IPGT&RA) Jamnagar (govt)
All India Institute of Ayurveda Delhi (govt)
Banaras Hindu University - Faculty of Ayurveda (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Strong wellness-resort employment in USA, UAE, Germany, Nepal, Sri Lanka. Direct medical licensing abroad limited; consultancy/wellness-resort and integrative-medicine pathways open.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Patient consultations using Ayurvedic diagnostics (pulse/tongue), prescribing herbal formulations, panchakarma supervision (oil massage, enemas, nasal therapies), wellness-program design.
sub_paths.growth_path: Ayurvedic Doctor → Senior → MD Ayurveda → AYUSH MO (govt) / Wellness-Resort Director / Pharma R&D (Dabur, Himalaya, Patanjali, Baidyanath). Cross-reference: covered in MED domain (MED-03) clinically.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3-7 LPA / Mid: 6-14 LPA / Senior: 12-30 LPA. Note: AYUSH MO Level 10 ₹56,100 basic; pharma R&D (Himalaya, Dabur) 6-12L; wellness resort 5-10L; cross-ref MED-03 for clinical depth. Source: AYUSH Ministry, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: BHMS - Homeopathy (Wellness/Preventive Angle)
sub_paths.description: 5.5-year AYUSH degree in Homeopathy — chronic care practice, low-cost OPDs, govt AYUSH MO route. Cross-references MED-04.
sub_paths.qualification: Bachelor of Homeopathic Medicine and Surgery (BHMS) — 4.5 yrs + 1 yr internship
top_institutions: Bharati Vidyapeeth Homoeopathic Med College Pune (private)
Father Muller Homoeopathic Med College Mangalore (private)
JSPS Govt Homoeopathic Med College Hyderabad (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Homeopathy regulated differently across countries — practice viable in Germany, France, UK, Switzerland (where homeopathy has regulatory frameworks). USA limited recognition.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Patient case-taking (often 30-60 min for chronic cases), constitutional analysis, prescription of dilutions, follow-up care. Quieter practice tempo than allopathy.
sub_paths.growth_path: Homoeopathic Doctor → MD Hom → AYUSH MO / Independent Practice / Pharma R&D (SBL, Hahnemann, Bakson). Cross-reference: covered in MED domain (MED-04) clinically.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2.5-5 LPA / Mid: 5-10 LPA / Senior: 10-22 LPA. Note: AYUSH MO Level 10 ₹56,100 basic; private practice variable; pharma R&D 4-9L; cross-ref MED-04 for clinical depth. Source: AYUSH Ministry, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: BUMS - Unani (Wellness/Preventive Angle)
sub_paths.description: 5.5-year AYUSH degree in Unani medicine — Greco-Arabic system, herbal/dietary therapeutics, AYUSH MO route. Cross-references MED-05.
sub_paths.qualification: Bachelor of Unani Medicine and Surgery (BUMS) — 4.5 yrs + 1 yr internship
top_institutions: National Institute of Unani Medicine Bangalore (govt)
AMU - Ajmal Khan Tibbiya College Aligarh (govt)
Aliah University Kolkata - Faculty of Unani (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Strongest pathway: Gulf countries with Unani recognition (UAE, Saudi Arabia for traditional medicine departments), Bangladesh, Pakistan, Iran.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Patient consultation using mizaj (temperament) diagnostics, prescribing Unani formulations, regimental therapies (cupping, massage). Often serves communities with culturally-aligned demand.
sub_paths.growth_path: Unani Doctor → MD Unani → AYUSH MO / Independent Practice / Hamdard/Hakim Ajmal Khan-style pharma. Cross-reference: MED-05 covers clinical aspect.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2.5-5 LPA / Mid: 5-10 LPA / Senior: 10-20 LPA. Note: AYUSH MO Level 10 ₹56,100 basic; private practice variable; Hamdard/Saira Pharma 4-9L; cross-ref MED-05. Source: AYUSH Ministry, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Siddha Medicine
sub_paths.description: 5.5-year AYUSH degree in Siddha — South Indian traditional medicine system, Tamil Nadu-centric practice, AYUSH MO route.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 50% in PCB + Tamil for some govt colleges; NEET-UG mandatory
sub_paths.qualification: Bachelor of Siddha Medicine and Surgery (BSMS) — 4.5 yrs + 1 yr internship
sub_paths.govt_fees: Govt Siddha colleges TN ₹30K-2 lakh total
top_institutions: Sri Sairam Siddha Medical College Chennai (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Limited — Sri Lanka, Singapore, Malaysia have Tamil-diaspora demand for Siddha practitioners. Less internationally recognized than Ayurveda or Yoga.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Patient diagnostics using nadi (pulse), naa (tongue), neikuri (oil drop test); prescribing Siddha herbo-mineral formulations; rasa-shastra (alchemical) preparations.
sub_paths.growth_path: Siddha Doctor → MD Siddha → AYUSH MO / Independent Practice. Tamil Nadu State AYUSH dept primary employer; some pharma roles at IMPCOPS/SKM Siddha.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2.5-5 LPA / Mid: 5-9 LPA / Senior: 8-18 LPA. Note: AYUSH MO Level 10 ₹56,100 basic; TN-state Siddha posts 4-7L; private practice variable; pharma 4-8L. Source: AYUSH Ministry, TN State Health Dept.

sub_paths.name: Aromatherapy / Holistic Therapy
sub_paths.description: Essential-oil based therapy practice — wellness centres, spas, integrative medicine clinics. Niche but growing post-pandemic wellness trend.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 12th pass; some programs no academic cutoff
sub_paths.qualification: Diploma in Aromatherapy / IFA-certified (International Federation of Aromatherapists) / NAHA-certified
sub_paths.private_fees: VLCC/IIAA Mumbai/Asha Khanna Aromatherapy 30K-2 lakh; IFA-aligned programmes 60K-2.5 lakh
top_institutions: Institute of Holistic Health Sciences Delhi (private)
Asha Khanna's Indian Institute of Aromatherapy Mumbai (private)
International Federation of Aromatherapists India chapter (semi-govt, professional body)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: IFA / NAHA certifications globally portable. UAE/UK/Australia/USA spa-industry hiring. Cruise-line wellness programs hire Indian-trained aromatherapists.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Client consultation, custom essential-oil blending, massage with carrier-oil blends, spa-protocol delivery, retail product sales. Calm clinical/spa environment.
sub_paths.growth_path: Aromatherapist → Senior Therapist → Spa Manager / Independent Practice / Educator. Spa chains (Four Seasons, Taj Spa, Oberoi Spa) hire heavily.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2-4 LPA / Mid: 4-9 LPA / Senior: 8-20 LPA. Note: Spa chains 2.5-5L; resort spa managers 6-12L; Gulf/cruise lines 5-12L; independent practice variable. Source: AmbitionBox, IFA.

sub_paths.name: Reflexology / Acupressure
sub_paths.description: Pressure-point therapy — foot/hand reflexology, acupressure for pain management. Integrative-medicine adjunct practice.
sub_paths.govt_fees: Limited govt route; AYUSH-recognised institute programs 15K-50K
sub_paths.private_fees: VLCC/Asha Khanna/ICRI ₹25K-1 lakh; international cert programs ₹50K-2 lakh
top_institutions: International College of Reflexology India ICRI (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: International reflexology certifications (RAA, ARCB) globally portable. Spa industry in UAE, Singapore, Maldives, Thailand hires actively.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Client sessions (30-60 min foot/hand work), occasional acupressure for specific issues, integration with massage practice. Calm clinical/spa setting.
sub_paths.growth_path: Reflexologist → Senior Therapist → Independent Practice / Spa Manager / Educator. Often combined with aromatherapy/massage for full holistic-therapy practice.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2-4 LPA / Mid: 4-8 LPA / Senior: 7-18 LPA. Note: Hotel/resort spa 2.5-5L; Gulf/cruise 5-10L; independent practice highly variable; tier-1 city specialists 6-12L. Source: AmbitionBox.

confidence_notes: VLCC, Lakmé, Shahnaz Husain academy fees verified via institute websites for 2026; PMKVY Beauty & Wellness courses confirmed free for eligible candidates under MSDE.
BNYS data verified — 5.5-yr duration, govt fees ₹20K-2L total, salary 3-6 LPA fresh, NEET requirement varying by state; S-VYASA Bangalore confirmed NAAC A+ Centre of Excellence.
Yoga Teacher RYT-200 data verified via Yoga Alliance and S-VYASA fee structures; international rates reflect 2026 wellness-tourism market.
Nutrition & Dietetics confidence 'high' — Lady Irwin/IHE/SNDT placement reports and AmbitionBox data align well.
BAMS, BHMS, BUMS cross-referenced from MED domain (Run 1, MED-03/04/05) — here reframed for wellness/preventive lens; clinical depth lives in Medicine domain.
Siddha confidence 'low' — practitioner pool is Tamil Nadu-centric and salary disclosures sparse; figures derived from TN State Health Dept and AYUSH Ministry.
Aromatherapy and Reflexology confidence 'low' — informal sector with wide pay variance; figures based on spa-industry disclosures and AmbitionBox.
Personal Training salary bands verified via Cult.fit, Talwarkars, Gold's Gym AmbitionBox data; ACE/NASM/ISSA cert costs from cert-body websites.
